status: frozen after the v19H discrete member-phase gate failed in both clusters and before any continuous member bandwidth score, density mode, velocity-current field, persistence bootstrap, causal-source construction, replacement-cluster lensing access, or gravity fit
purpose: Test whether a continuous source-only member density and line-of-sight phase field identifies merger structure that the preregistered discrete Gaussian mixture did not, without forcing a component count or using published subcluster labels.

coordinate_construction.origin: component-wise median member right ascension and declination within each complete frozen catalog
coordinate_construction.x_kpc: (RA-RA_median) cos(Dec_median) times 3600 times the frozen Planck18 kpc-per-arcsec conversion
coordinate_construction.y_kpc: (Dec-Dec_median) times 3600 times the frozen Planck18 kpc-per-arcsec conversion
coordinate_construction.position_measurement_error: negligible relative to the minimum 50-kpc kernel and therefore set to zero

spatial_kernel.selection: maximize the summed leave-one-out log density of all catalog positions; ties within 1e-12 select the larger bandwidth

continuous_fields.grid_bounds: for each selected bandwidth, floor each catalog minimum minus three bandwidths and ceil each maximum plus three bandwidths to the fixed 5-kpc lattice
continuous_fields.mass_weighting: none because a common homogeneous stellar-mass observable is absent from the two frozen catalogs
continuous_fields.frame_dragging_claim_boundary: j_los is a number-current geometry proxy, not a physical baryonic mass-current source; no Lense-Thirring amplitude may be inferred until common photometry and stellar-mass uncertainties are acquired

topological_modes.construction: descending-density superlevel-set union-find merge tree on the fixed 5-kpc grid
topological_modes.mode_birth: a new connected component at a local density maximum
topological_modes.mode_death: the saddle density at which that component first merges into a component with a higher peak
topological_modes.global_mode_death: the minimum positive density on the finite padded evaluation grid, making the surviving global maximum a finite-grid persistent mode
topological_modes.equal_density_rule: break an exact density tie by lexicographic flattened-grid index; a zero-persistence tie artifact cannot pass the ratio gate
topological_modes.edge_mode_rule: discard a mode whose peak lies within one selected bandwidth of the evaluation-grid boundary
topological_modes.primary_pair_rule: among persistent modes, select the pair maximizing the product of their peak densities; break an exact tie by greater separation and then lexicographic x/y coordinates

uncertainty.bandwidth_rule: repeat the same leave-one-out bandwidth selection inside every bootstrap rather than condition on the primary bandwidth
uncertainty.mode_matching: minimum-total-distance one-to-one assignment from the two frozen primary modes to all persistent bootstrap modes; a primary mode is recovered only when its assigned distance is at most 100 kpc

gates.failure_rule: fail continuous source identifiability; do not narrow the bandwidth grid, lower persistence or recovery thresholds, force two modes, use published labels or coordinates, or inspect lensing targets

advance_rule.if_passed: the continuous mode/current field may replace only the failed discrete-member portion of V19H; all frozen X-ray edge, thermodynamic, projection, clock, and lensing-seal rules remain unchanged
advance_rule.if_failed: retire these member catalogs as an independently identifying assembly coordinate and require richer source-side photometry or integral-field velocities before another member-current test
